cards.name: Strike A Good Match
cards.rules_text:
(A character with cost 2 or more can {E} to sing this song for free.) 

Draw 2 cards, then choose and discard a card.

cards.name: Mushu
cards.subtitle: Stealthy Dragon
cards.rules_text:
<Evasive> (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)

\Tip the Scales\ Whenever this character quests, if an opponent has more cards in their hand than you, you may draw a card.

cards.name: Tod
cards.subtitle: Clever Fox
cards.rules_text: \Problem Solving\ When you play this character, draw 2 cards, then choose and discard a card.

cards.name: Donald Duck
cards.subtitle: Perfect Gentleman
cards.rules_text:
<Shift> 3 {I} (You may pay 3 {I} to play this on top of one of your characters named Donald Duck.)

\Allow Me\ At the start of your turn, each player may draw a card.

cards.name: Dr. Bushroot
cards.subtitle: Evil Botanist
cards.rules_text:
<Ward> (Opponents can't choose this character except to challenge.)

\Fair is Fair\ Whenever this character is challenged, chosen opponent chooses and discards a card.

cards.name: Milo Thatch
cards.subtitle: Getting His Hands Dirty
cards.rules_text:
<Ward>

\Scholar's Gambit\ When you play this character, you may choose and discard a card to return chosen character to their player's hand.

\Practical Knowledge\ At the end of your turn, if 2 or more cards were put into your discard this turn, draw a card.

cards.name: Under the Sea
cards.rules_text:
<Sing Together> 8 (Any number of your or your teammates’ characters with total cost 8 or more may {E} to sing this song for free.)
Put all opposing characters with 2 {S} or less on the bottom of their players’ decks in any order.

cards.name: Mickey Mouse & Minnie Mouse
cards.subtitle: Adventuring Duo
cards.rules_text:
<Duo Shift> 0 {I} (You may pay 0 {I} to play this on top of two of your characters, one named Mickey Mouse and one named Minnie Mouse.)

\Thinking of You\ If this character would be banished, put them into your inkwell facedown and exerted instead.

cards.name: Minnie Mouse
cards.subtitle: Practical Traveler
cards.rules_text: \Discerning Eye\ Whenever this character quests, if you played another character this turn, gain 1 lore.

cards.name: Mickey Mouse
cards.subtitle: Bob Cratchit
cards.rules_text:
\Hard Work\ Whenever this character quests, put the top card of your deck facedown under him.

\A Giving Heart\ When this character is banished in a challenge, you may put all cards that were under him under another chosen character or location of yours.

cards.name: Mickey Mouse
cards.subtitle: Detective
cards.rules_text: \Get a Clue\ When you play this character, you may put the top card of your deck into your inkwell facedown and exerted.

cards.name: Scuttle
cards.subtitle: Birdbrained
cards.rules_text: <Ward> (Opponents can't choose this character except to challenge.)

cards.name: Hades
cards.subtitle: Meticulous Schemer
cards.rules_text: <Ward> (Opponents can't choose this character except to challenge.)

cards.name: Hades
cards.subtitle: Infernal Schemer
cards.rules_text: \Is There a Downside to This?\ When you play this character, you may put chosen opposing character into their player's inkwell facedown.
